what: The few-free-variables surrogate for instratus_condensate over the PI-atm month: the same model as the fifty-step run 7371974 (MLP, 72,454 parameters, the routine's closure verbatim after it) in the slot through --kernel-model, 1488 steps requested, replay boundary.
outcome: model run exited 174: SIGSEGV on all 512 ranks at once during physics step 984 (day 20.5 of 31); 983 steps completed, ten two-day history files written (days 1 to 19); no Python traceback, no Fortran backtrace (the image is not built with traceback)

health.big_error_trend: flat: about 16,000 per 3.3 days from the first day to the last
health.note: the original physics prints none of these in fifty steps; q1q2 uqdiff is the deep-convection water-tracer updraft check (water_tracers.F90 wtrc_q1q2_pjr), the uwshcu line says a column's source air was too dry for a lifting condensation level

history.first_difference: ADRAIN in cam.h0.0001-01-03-07200.nc, as a model in the slot must differ

diagnosis: The state left the physical range before the fault.  The water-tracer check after the macrophysics fired at a steady rate from the first day (the mechanism is in docs/physics_kernel_decoupling.md: the surrogate's in-stratus state is not the saturation adjustment's, the driver's next-iteration linearisation drives the vapor negative, positive_moisture repairs it, and the negative net water tendency is dropped from the H2O copies), the deep-convection tracer check and the shallow-convection dry-source warnings grew from a handful to a thousand per three days, and twenty-one isotopic precipitation mass errors were printed.  The segmentation fault itself is not diagnosed: it struck every rank in the same step and left no backtrace.
disposition: Kept as the month result of this model.  The next model keeps saturation as well as conservation: predict the stratus fractions only and take the in-stratus condensates from the saturation adjustment at the predicted fractions, then run the month again.  The health record, the bit-for-bit record and the drift record are committed with this file.
